title: Meet Maison Debrah at CIFF Shanghai 2026
content:
The 31st China International Furniture Fair (Pudong, Shanghai)
Maison Debrah proudly returns to the China International Furniture Fair in Shanghai, one of Asia’s leading international platforms for furniture, interior design, and luxury living.

Discover our latest collections, curated interior concepts, and complete solutions for retail, hospitality, residential, and commercial environments. Meet our international team and explore how Maison Debrah combines nearly three decades of craftsmanship with a contemporary global design vision.

Whether you are a retailer, importer, interior designer, hospitality developer, or investor, we invite you to experience a world where timeless elegance meets commercial opportunity.

Visit us
China International Furniture Fair (Pudong, Shanghai)
8–11 September 2026
Stand E6 C35

We look forward to welcoming you and exploring how we can shape the future of luxury interiors together.

"Thank you. A member of our team will be in touch to confirm your appointment at Stands 1.1C10 & 1.1B01, CIFF 2026 — 18 to 21 March, Guangzhou."
RSVP contact email: contact@maisondebrah.com

title: China (Guangzhou) | From 18 – 21 March 2026
content:
Maison Debrah at CIFF 2026
— China International Furniture Fair, Guangzhou

At the China International Furniture Fair 2026, Maison Debrah unveils a curated world of refined interiors. Rooted in nearly three decades of craftsmanship and global design expertise, the collection reflects a philosophy where form, material, and atmosphere come together to shape spaces of enduring elegance.

Conceived as an immersive interior environment, the stand invites visitors to experience the Maison Debrah aesthetic firsthand. Signature furniture pieces, architectural compositions, and layered materials reveal a complete design vision.

Stand details
Stand: 1.1C10 & 1.1B01 — Canton Fair Complex, Guangzhou
Dates: 18 – 21 March 2026
Edition: 30 Year Anniversary

title: Milan (Italy) | From 21 – 25 April 2026
content:
Maison Debrah × Freshbed
— Salone del Mobile, Milan

At Salone del Mobile Milano, Maison Debrah presents an immersive bedroom experience in collaboration with Freshbed.

The stand is conceived as a refined retreat, where luxury bedrooms take center stage. Sculptural beds, layered materials, and a calm architectural rhythm come together to express comfort, craftsmanship, and quiet elegance.

Together, Maison Debrah and Freshbed redefine the bedroom as more than a place to sleep — a curated space for rest, balance, and elevated living.

Stand: A36, hall 5
